verdict.rationale: Brevo documents an MCP integration that lets AI assistants interact with the account, and says users can manage campaigns and contacts from ChatGPT and Claude. Contact lists are also available programmatically, so audiences and campaigns are reachable by an agent. Missing for 10: documented programmatic read access to live automations/workflows, documented API or MCP access to marketing campaign results and stats (the only analytics export covers 7 days of transactional events), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent reporting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my whole email program — audiences, live automations, recent campaign results — programmatically and report on what's working

citations.quote: Enable AI models to interact with your Brevo account through standardized endpoints.
Manage campaigns and contacts directly from ChatGPT, Claude & other AI tools
Import, update, and organize your contact lists programmatically.
Export raw data of all transactional events from the past 7 days. Generate reports with unaggregated data for analytics.
